description: RFC 0080 core builtin control. The data-center module against its own example. Eleven calcs compute - including the two per-unit metrics read from the STANDARD sections (frontmatter quick_metrics and noi_model), which is the RFC 0039 finding; CC-DC-04 (contracted above commissioned, a pre-leased phase) and CC-DC-07 (rent 20% under the comp set) fire; no error. The first product module on a module-declared class, end to end.
